name: Open Reliability Cases
description: The count of reliability cases that are not yet in a terminal (closed) workflow state.

name: Cases by Severity
description: The distribution of open reliability cases grouped by severity level.

name: Average Time to Triage
description: The average elapsed time between a fault-reported event and the first inspection-completed or maintenance-completed event addressing it.

name: Repeat Fault Count
description: The count of repeated-fault signals raised across the fleet in the current reporting window.

name: Repeat Fault Trend
description: The count of repeated-fault signals raised per period over time, used to visualise recurrence trends across the fleet.

name: Overdue Actions
description: The count of open action items whose due date has passed, or that are at risk of missing their due date, per the overdue-repair signal logic.

name: Assets Awaiting Approval
description: The count of assets with a proposed remove-from-service decision awaiting human approval.

name: Estimated Downtime Exposure
description: A hypothetical estimate of downtime hours at risk if assets currently carrying open, unresolved reliability signals were to fail outright, derived from historical downtime-hours observations on comparable assets. This is a forward-looking estimate, never an observed measurement, and must not be presented as fact.

name: Critical Signals
description: The count of currently open signals at critical severity across the fleet.

name: Pending Decisions
description: The count of proposed decisions across the fleet that have not yet reached a final approved or rejected outcome.

name: Recent Reliability Activity
description: A rolling feed of the most recent operational events, signals, and case updates across the fleet.
